knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,

library(circlize)
library(dplyr)

set.seed(1031)

## 设计说明

本例使用模拟数据复现参考图中的环形多性状棒棒糖布局。十二个疾病领域排列在灰色分区环中；径向线段和端点表示基因的 selection score；蓝色表示保护性关联，橙色表示风险关联；中心弦线表示跨疾病领域的模拟共享关联。

> 所有数据均为绘图演示用途，不代表真实医学结论。

## 模拟基因评分数据

```{r simulate-gene-data}
gene_sets <- list(
  `Type 2 diabetes` = c("ADIPOQ", "GCK", "KCNJ11", "IGF2", "PPARG"),
  `Prostate cancer` = c("HPC1", "MSR1", "RNASEL", "BRCA1", "HOXB13"),
  `Premature mortality` = c("GDF15", "NFE2L2", "FOXO3", "HAVCR1", "NLRP3"),
  COPD = c("DPP9", "CXCL17", "CDON", "IL31", "CDC42"),
  `Lung cancer` = c("CXCL13", "GDF5", "FGF10", "MMP9", "LAMP3"),
  `Renal disease` = c("UMOD", "LAMB2", "NPHS1", "APOL1", "MANBA"),
  `Heart failure` = c("NPPB", "GNAS", "RNASE4", "FURIN", "TIMP1"),
  `Alzheimer's disease` = c("APOE", "CLU", "CR1", "BIN1", "PICALM"),
  Glaucoma = c("PITX2", "TPBG", "VEGFA", "ANGPT1", "IL23"),
  `Breast cancer` = c("CTAG1A", "BRCA2", "ESR1", "GABRA2", "GBP4"),
  `Acute pancreatitis` = c("CLSTN3", "ZP1", "MZB1", "LRIG3", "PRSS1"),
  Multimorbidity = c("WFDC2", "PLXNB2", "EDA2R", "CKAP4", "GDF3")
)

category_names <- names(gene_sets)

gene_data <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(gene_sets), function(i) {
  data.frame(
    category = category_names[i],
    category_id = i,
    gene = gene_sets[[i]],
    gene_index = seq_along(gene_sets[[i]])
  )
})) |>
  group_by(category) |>
  mutate(
    score = sort(
      runif(n(), 0.10, 0.98),
      decreasing = first(category_id) %% 2 == 0
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(runif(n()) < 0.31, "Risk", "Protective"),
    gene_id = row_number(),
    category = factor(category, levels = category_names)
  )

# 保证两类颜色在圆周各部分均有代表，同时保持结果可重复。
gene_data$direction[c(3, 14, 27, 38, 49, 58)] <- "Risk"
gene_data$direction[c(8, 20, 32, 44, 55)] <- "Protective"

association_palette <- c(
  Protective = "#0B5C8E",
  Risk = "#E78668"
)

write.csv(
  gene_data |>
    select(category, gene, score, direction, gene_index),
  "synthetic_gene_scores.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

head(gene_data)
```

## 模拟跨疾病连接

```{r simulate-connections}
set.seed(1031)
n_links <- 36
from_ids <- sample(gene_data$gene_id, n_links, replace = FALSE)
to_ids <- sample(gene_data$gene_id, n_links, replace = TRUE)

for (i in seq_len(n_links)) {
  from_category <- as.character(gene_data$category[gene_data$gene_id == from_ids[i]])
  to_category <- as.character(gene_data$category[gene_data$gene_id == to_ids[i]])

  while (from_category == to_category || from_ids[i] == to_ids[i]) {
    to_ids[i] <- sample(gene_data$gene_id, 1)
    to_category <- as.character(gene_data$category[gene_data$gene_id == to_ids[i]])
  }
}

connections <- data.frame(
  link_id = seq_len(n_links),
  from_id = from_ids,
  to_id = to_ids
) |>
  left_join(
    gene_data |>
      transmute(
        from_id = gene_id,
        from_gene = gene,
        from_category = as.character(category),
        from_x = gene_index
      ),
    by = "from_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    gene_data |>
      transmute(
        to_id = gene_id,
        to_gene = gene,
        to_category = as.character(category),
        to_x = gene_index
      ),
    by = "to_id"
  )

write.csv(
  connections |>
    select(link_id, from_gene, from_category, to_gene, to_category),
  "synthetic_connections.csv",
  row.names = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

head(connections)
```

## 环形绘图函数

```{r plot-function}
render_circular_lollipop <- function() {
  circos.clear()
  on.exit(circos.clear(), add = TRUE)

  par(mar = c(2.8, 1.2, 3.6, 1.2), xpd = NA)

  circos.par(
    start.degree = 94,
    gap.degree = 2.8,
    track.margin = c(0.006, 0.006),
    cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
    points.overflow.warning = FALSE,
    canvas.xlim = c(-1.10, 1.10),
    canvas.ylim = c(-1.10, 1.10)
  )

  sector_limits <- cbind(
    rep(0.35, length(category_names)),
    lengths(gene_sets) + 0.65
  )

  circos.initialize(
    factors = category_names,
    xlim = sector_limits
  )

  # 外圈：基因标签和短引线。
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    track.height = 0.20,
    bg.border = NA,
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
      sector <- CELL_META$sector.index
      sector_genes <- gene_data |>
        filter(as.character(category) == sector)

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(sector_genes))) {
        colour <- association_palette[sector_genes$direction[i]]
        position <- sector_genes$gene_index[i]

        circos.segments(
          position, 0.02, position, 0.18,
          col = adjustcolor(colour, alpha.f = 0.72),
          lwd = 0.65
        )
        circos.text(
          position, 0.22,
          sector_genes$gene[i],
          facing = "clockwise",
          niceFacing = TRUE,
          adj = c(0, 0.5),
          cex = 0.49,
          font = 2,
          col = colour
        )
      }
    }
  )

  # 灰色疾病分区环。
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    track.height = 0.095,
    bg.col = "#F0F1F1",
    bg.border = "#62696C",
    bg.lwd = 0.9,
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
      circos.text(
        CELL_META$xcenter,
        CELL_META$ycenter,
        CELL_META$sector.index,
        facing = "bending.inside",
        niceFacing = TRUE,
        cex = 0.52,
        font = 2,
        col = "#343A3C"
      )
    }
  )

  # 内圈：selection score 网格、径向棒和端点。
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    track.height = 0.30,
    bg.col = "white",
    bg.border = "#6D7476",
    bg.lwd = 0.75,
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
      sector <- CELL_META$sector.index
      sector_genes <- gene_data |>
        filter(as.character(category) == sector)

      for (grid_value in seq(0.2, 1, by = 0.2)) {
        circos.lines(
          CELL_META$xlim,
          c(grid_value, grid_value),
          col = "#D8DCDD",
          lwd = 0.45,
          lty = 3
        )
      }

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(sector_genes))) {
        colour <- association_palette[sector_genes$direction[i]]
        position <- sector_genes$gene_index[i]
        score <- sector_genes$score[i]

        circos.segments(
          position, 0,
          position, score,
          col = adjustcolor(colour, alpha.f = 0.72),
          lwd = 0.75
        )
        circos.points(
          position, score,
          pch = 16,
          cex = 0.58,
          col = colour
        )
      }

      if (sector == category_names[1]) {
        circos.yaxis(
          side = "left",
          at = seq(0.2, 1, by = 0.2),
          labels = sprintf("%.1f", seq(0.2, 1, by = 0.2)),
          labels.cex = 0.40,
          tick.length = convert_x(0.08, "mm"),
          lwd = 0.55,
          col = "#4D5558"
        )
        circos.text(
          CELL_META$xlim[1] - 0.48,
          0.50,
          "Selection score",
          facing = "clockwise",
          niceFacing = TRUE,
          cex = 0.45,
          font = 2,
          col = "#3F4648"
        )
      }
    }
  )

  # 中心跨疾病弦线。
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(connections))) {
    link_colour <- if (i %% 5 == 0) {
      adjustcolor("#0B5C8E", alpha.f = 0.32)
    } else {
      adjustcolor("#274B50", alpha.f = 0.43)
    }

    circos.link(
      connections$from_category[i],
      c(connections$from_x[i] - 0.032, connections$from_x[i] + 0.032),
      connections$to_category[i],
      c(connections$to_x[i] - 0.032, connections$to_x[i] + 0.032),
      col = link_colour,
      border = NA,
      h.ratio = 0.58
    )
  }

  title(
    main = "Circular Multi-trait Lollipop Plot",
    line = 1.50,
    cex.main = 1.25,
    font.main = 2,
    col.main = "#252A2C"
  )
  mtext(
    "Synthetic biomarker associations across 12 disease domains",
    side = 3,
    line = 0.05,
    cex = 0.72,
    col = "#5B6265"
  )

  legend(
    "bottom",
    inset = -0.018,
    legend = c("Protective", "Risk"),
    col = association_palette[c("Protective", "Risk")],
    pch = 16,
    pt.cex = 0.85,
    horiz = TRUE,
    bty = "n",
    cex = 0.75,
    title = "Association"
  )
}
```

## 绘图并导出

```{r circular-lollipop, fig.width=11, fig.height=11}
render_circular_lollipop()

png(
  "circular_lollipop.png",
  width = 3520,
  height = 3520,
  res = 320,
  bg = "white"
)
render_circular_lollipop()
dev.off()
```

## 输出文件

- `circular_lollipop.html`：自包含 R Markdown 编译结果；
- `circular_lollipop.png`：320 dpi 高清图片；
- `synthetic_gene_scores.csv`：模拟基因 selection score；
- `synthetic_connections.csv`：模拟跨疾病连接。
